description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Custom' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_ChildDef'. It implements custom validation logic for DTD child definitions, including regex compilation and child validation methods.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Custom
classes.description: A class to validate HTML element children based on DTD patterns, supporting regex compilation and child validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a DTD regex and compiles the corresponding PCRE regex.

methods.name: _compileRegex
methods.description: Transforms the DTD regex into a PCRE regex used for validation.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates a list of child nodes against the compiled regex pattern.
